title: 第5章 来找男人的风二娘第6章 给你机会你把握不住
content_zh:
顺风客栈，天字乙号房。
当当当——！
陆天明叩响房门。
吱——！
房门打开。
映入眼帘便是一大片纯粹的白。
陆天明借故咳嗽，别开脸。
“你小子，胆儿挺肥！”
见到门口跛脚站着的陆天明，女人颇为诧异。
“我胆子小，怕死，所以来找你，可以进来吗？”
“不进来做什么，难不成站在门口谈价钱？”
女人姿色中等偏上，算不得闭月羞花，但胜在一个得天独厚。
属实是陆天明二十年来见过最厚的。
最关键的是，人家舍得，不藏着掖着。
“姑娘，敢问芳名？”陆天明坐下后问道。
“呵，听闻乡亲们叫你秀才，这水平也不咋地，姑娘还是妇人，看不出来？”女人讥笑道。
陆天明抹了抹额头：“这不是见您长得跟小姑娘似的，有点紧张。姐，你叫什么名字？”
“嘴倒是挺甜，叫我风二娘，真名就算了。回头你去告大状，我又得进去。”
女人给陆天明倒了杯茶，坐到床上。
二郎腿一翘，短裙，风光无限好。

“疯子的疯？”陆天明奇道。
“风水的风！”风二娘翻了个白眼。
“风姐，说笑了，告状也看人。”
来都来了，陆天明大大方方承认是自己报的信。
“哦，花蝴蝶不像好人，你就告状，我胸前多二两，你怜香惜玉？”
风二娘晃动小腿，腿肚子来回挤压中勾出一抹诱人的弧度。
陆天明收回视线，变了个人似的。
“你们杀人或者越货，与我无关，但是杨家，不行，如果你还惦记杨家，我一样要做小人。”
见陆天明突然变得一本正经，风二娘挑了挑眉。
“理由？”
“杨家大小姐对我有恩，人嘛，又不是猪狗，要讲究知恩图报。”
“救过你的命？哪怕知道我们是道上的？”
“救命倒是不至于，那年天寒地冻，肚子饿，吃了杨大小姐两个包子，肉的。”
风二娘闻言，手肘抻在膝盖上，支着下巴，眼眸闪动。
“合着花蝴蝶进大牢，是因为俩包子？”
“主要是因为我喜欢吃包子。”陆天明嘴角上扬，笑得很好看。
风二娘再次打量陆天明。
穿着读书人的长袍，袍子很旧，但洗得很干净。
content_en:
Shunfeng Inn, Room B, Tianzi.
Dangdangdang——!
Lu Tianming knocked on the door.
squeak--!
The door opens.
What comes into view is a large expanse of pure white.
Lu Tianming made an excuse to cough and looked away.
"You boy, you are very brave!"
The woman was quite surprised when she saw Lu Tianming standing lamely at the door.
"I am timid and afraid of death, so I came to see you. Can you come in?"
"What are you going to do if you don't come in? Why don't you stand at the door and negotiate the price?"
The woman's appearance is average to above average, and she is not considered a beauty, but she is better than a woman blessed by nature.
It is truly the thickest Lu Tianming has seen in twenty years.
The most important thing is that people are willing to let it go and don't hide it.
"Girl, may I ask your name?" Lu Tianming asked after sitting down.
"Haha, I heard that the folks call you a scholar, but your level is not very good. You are a girl, but you are still a woman. Can't you tell?" the woman sneered.
Lu Tianming wiped his forehead: "I see you look like a little girl, so I'm a little nervous. Sister, what's your name?"
"You're quite sweet. Call me Feng Erniang. Forget it by my real name. You can file a complaint later and I'll have to go in again."
The woman poured Lu Tianming a cup of tea and sat on the bed.
Erlang's legs are lifted up, and she wears a short skirt, and the scenery is infinitely beautiful.
"A madman's madness?" Lu Tianming asked curiously.
"The wind of Feng Shui!" Feng Erniang rolled her eyes.
"Sister Feng, you are just joking. Complaining depends on the person."
Even though they were here, Lu Tianming openly admitted that he was the one who reported the letter.
"Oh, Butterfly doesn't look like a good person, so why don't you complain? I have two more taels on my chest, why do you show mercy to me?"
Feng Erniang shook her calf, and the calf squeezed back and forth to create a seductive arc.
Lu Tianming looked away, as if he was a different person.
"It has nothing to do with you killing people or cheating, but the Yang family, no, if you still care about the Yang family, I will still be a villain."
Seeing Lu Tianming suddenly become serious, Feng Erniang raised her eyebrows.
"Reason?"
"The eldest lady of the Yang family has been kind to me. Humans are not pigs or dogs. We must pay attention to repaying kindness."
"Saved your life? Even if you knew we were on the right path?"
"It's not a life-saving thing. It was freezing that year and I was hungry. I ate two meat buns from Miss Yang."
When Feng Erniang heard this, she stretched her elbows on her knees, supported her chin, and her eyes flashed.
"Is it because of two buns that I went to jail together with Hua Di?"
"Mainly because I like eating steamed buns." Lu Tianming raised the corners of his mouth and smiled beautifully.
Feng Erniang looked at Lu Tianming again.
Wearing a scholar's robe, the robe is very old but very clean.
